newsitem.title: USA: A.P. Green Q1 net drops, sales edge up.
newsitem.headline: A.P. Green Q1 net drops, sales edge up.

text.p: A.P. Green Industries Inc on Wednesday said lower margins and operating losses by some of its units contributed to a decline in first-quarter earnings.

The specialty minerals distributor said net income fell to $811,000, or $0.10 a share, from $1.7 million, or $0.22, posted in the first quarter of 1996. Sales edged higher to $64.8 million from $64.2 million.

A.P. Green said a newly acquired plant in its lime operation was marginally profitable and plans for a new lime plant in Charleston, South Carolina, were on track. The new facility should become operational by the autumn of 1998, the company said.
A.P. Green shares were off 3/4 Wednesday at 8-1/4.
